strategic_recommendations.title: Lead with signature fashion-and-culture journeys
strategic_recommendations.rationale: Fashion, luxury, retail, and experiential themes recur in the captured evidence.

strategic_recommendations.title: Use AI for drafts with human approval
strategic_recommendations.rationale: Technology signals coexist with trust, expertise, and risk themes.
strategic_recommendations.suggested_action: Require specialist review and a source checklist before sending itineraries.

strategic_recommendations.title: Make resilience part of the offer
strategic_recommendations.rationale: Risk and disruption signals appear in travel coverage.
strategic_recommendations.suggested_action: Publish escalation, rebooking, traveler-alert, and data-protection commitments.

strategic_recommendations.title: Improve evidence depth
strategic_recommendations.rationale: Pricing signals appear on 4 sites and industries on 13 sites.
strategic_recommendations.suggested_action: Review low-yield sources monthly and maintain selectors with fixtures.

strategic_recommendations.title: Operate a monitored monthly scan
strategic_recommendations.rationale: Recurring decisions require freshness and source-level quality metrics.
strategic_recommendations.suggested_action: Schedule the pipeline, retain manifests, and alert on coverage or yield regressions.

guardrails: Record counts are extraction outputs, not market share or demand.

Forecasts are withheld unless the dated time series meets minimum sufficiency thresholds.
OpenAI synthesis, when enabled, must be reviewed against source records before external use.
